3. **Concrete Resources** - Look into online courses from platforms like Coursera, edX, or Udacity that offer specialized tracks in IoT applications within the context of smart cities and campuses. Remember to maintain a warm approach when seeking internships – highlighting not only your enthusiasm but also showcasing how the Smart Campus Connect initiative aligns with potential employer's goals and sustainability efforts can make your application stand out! Good luck on this exciting journey, and feel free to ask for more guidance whenever needed. Take your time.
